title: Every agent asks for its thinking and keeps it: no model call loses its reasoning
request: The owner, many times that night: the model's thinking must be kept for training, for every agent and every kind of help, past and future; it is crucial.
spec: Part A of the approved plan (thinking and reasoning for all data): every purpose thinks; keeping is on by default and leaving stays consent's; a gateway with no workspace still keeps a live reply; a shadow keeps its thinking; local models keep their reasoning; a test that no agent can drop its thinking.
plan: Measure what was kept before changing anything: every saved model call, by purpose.
Ask for thinking on every purpose but embedding, keep it by default, close each path that dropped it, with a test per path.
Review the diff adversarially and fix what the review finds.

decisions.decision: Keeping text is on unless switched off, and separate from whether a record may leave the workspace.
decisions.why: About 730 saved calls thought and kept only 'thought: true' because keeping was tied to the consent flag that decides leaving.

decisions.decision: An exam (a sealed or test split) keeps the shape of its calls only.
decisions.why: With keeping on by default, a sealed journey's calls would have become training data.

decisions.decision: A model that refuses a thinking request is asked again without it, once, and remembered.
decisions.why: The call matters more than its thinking; claude-sonnet-5-5 refuses a budget, older models refuse adaptive.

change: models/settings.py (NO_THINKING, every purpose thinks); experience model_text_allowed on by default, sealed_run(split) for 14 runners; models/gateway.py (prompts shown cells never logged, live fallback home, a shadow's own exchange line with thinking, cost estimated with the thinking's room); models/client.py (reasoning read without a configured field, inline think split at the start only); models/anthropic_client.py (budget vs adaptive by model, retry without thinking, output_config.effort); agent_eval/home: a sealed run is never kept; tests/test_thinking_everywhere.py.

findings.defect: Most model calls thought and kept only a flag.
findings.scenario: Of 2,095 saved calls, 723 had thought and kept only 'thought: true'; only 15 of 42 purposes asked for thinking.
findings.cause: Keeping text was tied to keeps_text, which decides only whether a record may leave the workspace.
findings.fix: Every purpose thinks; a purpose shown no cells keeps its exchange whole; leaving is still consent's (may_leave).

findings.defect: A process that never loaded .env kept no text.
findings.scenario: The twin's workflow lane, the lake benchmark and store reason kept only the shape of every call.

findings.defect: A local model's reasoning was dropped unless its tier named the field.
findings.scenario: A reply carrying reasoning_content kept none of it.
findings.cause: _reasoning returned nothing without a configured field.
findings.fix: The known fields are read; it is sent back only under a configured field.

findings.defect: With keeping on by default, prompts shown cell values went into the usage log.
findings.scenario: An intern call with no DCLAB_LOG_PROMPTS set wrote a table row (a contact and a card number) into model_requests.jsonl, which a tester's share sends.
findings.cause: The usage log's prompt never checked the purpose's cell values.
findings.fix: A prompt shown cells is never logged.

findings.defect: A shadow's reply and thinking were still dropped.
findings.scenario: The shadow log keeps only its comparison fields, so the new keys were filtered out; the shadow was never asked to think.
findings.cause: FileShadows and PgShadows write only FIELDS.
findings.fix: The shadow's call is its own exchange line, marked shadow, by the served model's rule; its transport is asked to think.

findings.defect: Sealed runs would have been kept whole.
findings.scenario: journeys --split sealed and the lake benchmark use a bare Gateway; with the live fallback their calls landed in agent_runs/model_exchanges.
findings.cause: Only the solver's exams switched keeping off.
findings.fix: experience.sealed_run(split) in every runner that can read a sealed split; a sealed Home evaluation keeps no drafts.
findings.test: the 14 runners import and the journeys and evaluation tests pass

findings.defect: Some Claude ids got a thinking request they refuse.
findings.scenario: Dated 4.0 ids were read as newer models; adaptive on claude-haiku-4-5 is refused.
findings.cause: The budget-model pattern missed them, and nothing retried without thinking.
findings.fix: The pattern covers them, older models get a budget, a refusal is retried once without thinking.

findings.scenario: A 50-token call reserved a small share of its real limit; concurrent capped runs could overshoot.
findings.cause: The estimate read the reply's limit, not the thinking's room.

findings.defect: An answer that mentions think tags lost its text.
findings.scenario: A notebook cell's code with re.sub(r'<think>...') was cut.
findings.fix: Only at the reply's start, or a lone closing tag with no opening one anywhere.

measurements.name: Saved model calls by what they kept, before the change
measurements.result: 2,095 saved calls: 317 whole with thinking blocks (later found to hold empty text, signature only), 429 whole without thinking, 723 shape-only that thought, 626 shape-only
limits: the saved calls of this machine's workspaces only
the 317 blocks hold no text: the model's default display omits it

outcome: From now on every agent's model calls ask for thinking and keep it whole in the workspace (cells redacted), exams excepted; the store can train on it.
lessons: Keeping data and letting it leave are two decisions; one flag for both lost about 730 thinking turns.
Turning a default on is a privacy change: check every reader of the switch, not only the new path.
risks: Every purpose now thinks, so each call costs more; DCLAB_THINKING=off is the switch.
